scenario_description:
Objective: Secure a no-cost advance hold for two side-gate stools during a confirmed Marigny brass evening, if it fits the companion’s comfort.
Emerging Need: A radio porch extra is only theoretical until the outing, attendance, transport, and open-stool notice align inside a brief reply window.
Decision Context: Stored social notes distinguish a welcome observer-style hold from an awkward participatory invitation, while event records establish timing, names, and cutoff.
Consequence: A timely request can secure seated, observer-only listening in advance. After advance replies close, that reservation route is lost; sidewalk listening and any walk-up availability are separate possibilities.

parameter.subject: Thursday brass cut: possible side-gate guest stools
parameter.body: For Thursday evening's Marigny live brass cut, we may open one or two pairs of no-cost side-gate guest stools for neighbors. A confirmation note will go out Wednesday if stools are actually available; holds will require attendee names before the afternoon cutoff.

parameter.content: If your Thursday Marigny brass drift is still happening, I can come after work. I can meet you near Frenchmen around 6:45 and just keep it easy.

parameter.subject: Two side-gate stools opened for Thursday live cut
parameter.body: Two side-gate guest stools are open for Thursday's 7:15-7:35 live brass cut. No cost, cancellable until 6:00 p.m. Thursday. Reply by 4:30 p.m. today with the two names and note whether the guests are observers only or open to being greeted on mic.

parameter.subject: Thursday side-gate stool list closed
parameter.body: The 4:30 p.m. reply window has closed, and unclaimed side-gate stools for Thursday's live cut have been released to walk-up neighbors. The brass walk route and open sidewalk listening remain unchanged.
